title: Greening of the Earth and its drivers

extraction_issues.quote: Zaichun Zhu $ ^{1,2} $ , Shilong Piao $ ^{1,2\star} $ , Ranga B. Myneni $ ^{3} $ , Mengtian Huang $ ^{2} $ , Zhenzhong Zeng $ ^{2} $ Josep G. Canadell $ ^{4} $
extraction_issues.reason: 作者列表中Zhenzhong Zeng与Josep G. Canadell之间缺少逗号，属OCR标点丢失，不影响理解。

extraction_issues.quote: Biogeochemical drivers include the fertilization effect of elevated atmospheric $ \mathrm{CO}{2} $ concentration $ \mathrm{(eCO{2})} $
extraction_issues.reason: CO₂和eCO₂的下标2在LaTeX中丢失，显示为CO{2}和eCO{2}，影响化学式准确性。

extraction_issues.quote: The GIMMS LAI3g data set, which includes recent data up to 2014, shows a continuation of the trend from the 1982 to 2009 period (Fig. 1 and Supplementary Fig. 3).
extraction_issues.reason: 正文提及GIMMS LAI3g数据包含截至2014年数据，但研究期主要为1982—2009，此处表述可能为原文内容，非OCR错误，但需注意时间范围。

extraction_issues.quote: The 95% confidence intervals of the scaling factors of $ \mathrm{CO_{2}} $ fertilization (best estimates of scaling factor $ \beta=1.03 $ , 95% confidence interval [0.84,1.23]) and climate change $ (\beta=1.06, [0.55,1.64]) $ are not only above zero but also span unity
extraction_issues.reason: 公式中β符号和区间格式基本正确，但原文中可能为β=1.03，此处提取无误。

extraction_issues.quote: Our estimation of $ \mathrm{CO_{2}} $ fertilization effects on vegetation growth is more prominent than $ \mathrm{Los}^{6} $ , probably owing to the different attribution approaches.
extraction_issues.reason: Los应为作者姓氏Los，但OCR提取为$ \mathrm{Los}^{6} $，格式错误，可能影响引用识别。

extraction_issues.quote: Climate change explains about 8.1 $ \pm $ 20.1% of the observed positive LAI trend
extraction_issues.reason: 此处数值8.1±20.1%与后文8.1±20.6%不一致，可能为OCR错误或原文笔误，需核对。

extraction_issues.quote: OF contributes the most to the observed LAI trend over 25.0% (increase) and 5.3% (decrease) of the vegetated area (Fig. 3d).
extraction_issues.reason: OF贡献比例25.0%和5.3%与摘要中25%—50%绿化区表述不同，但属不同指标，非OCR错误。

extraction_issues.quote: The optimal fingerprint expresses the observation (Y) as a linear combination of scaled $ (\beta_{i}) $ responses to external driving factors $ (x_{i}) $ , and internal variability $ (\varepsilon): $ $ Y=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\beta_{i}x_{i}+\varepsilon. $
extraction_issues.reason: 公式中β_i和x_i下标提取正确，但ε符号可能因OCR显示为$ \varepsilon $，基本可读。

extraction_issues.quote: Query 2: Please check. r=0.83 mentioned here r=0.85 in the artwork.
extraction_issues.reason: 查询指出正文r=0.83与图稿r=0.85不一致，属原文内部矛盾，非OCR错误，但影响数值一致性。

self_check: 已核对摘要、正文数据和结论中的关键数值：全球绿化趋势0.068±0.045 m² m⁻² yr⁻¹，MMEM趋势0.062 m² m⁻² yr⁻¹，CO₂施肥贡献70.1±29.4%，氮沉降8.8±11.8%，气候变化8.1±20.6%，LCC 3.7±14.7%。公式Y=∑β_i x_i+ε已保留。发现气候变化贡献在正文中一处为8.1±20.1%，另一处为8.1±20.6%，可能为OCR或原文笔误，已在extraction_issues中标注。其他数值与结论方向一致。
